title: Uruguayan Choripan with Russet Potato Wedges
description: A classic Uruguayan street food featuring grilled chorizo and crispy potato wedges. Serve with a side of pillowy bakes for dipping.
instructions: 2. Slice the chorizo into 1-inch pieces and grill for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
3. Meanwhile, slice the Russet potatoes into 1-inch wedges.
4. Toss the potato wedges with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
5. Grill the potato wedges for 5-7 minutes per side, or until crispy.
6. Warm the quick fix bakes according to package instructions.
7. Assemble the choripan by grilling the bakes, then topping with grilled chorizo and potato wedges.
8. Serve with a side of rich fix sauce, if desired.
